definitions: A parasitic disease caused by the filarial nematode Onchocerca volvulus, transmitted by blackflies, leading to severe itching, skin lesions, and eventual blindness.
Onchocerciasis, a tropical disease primarily affecting the eyes and skin, caused by a parasitic worm and transmitted by the bite of infected blackflies.
examples: The World Health Organization has programs to combat river blindness.
Mass drug administration is a key strategy against river blindness.
Early diagnosis can prevent the progression of river blindness.
